vectors.name: inheritance
vectors.description: A role held at a node reaches that node and everything beneath it, and nothing beside or above it. The nearest granting assignment is the effective node.

vectors.name: assignment-windows
vectors.description: Only an assignment in effect grants. One that has ended denies as expired; one that has not begun denies as if absent. Neither appears among the grant roots.

vectors.name: inactive-role
vectors.description: A role deactivated after it was assigned keeps its assignments but grants nothing; the identity's other roles still grant.

vectors.name: identity-status
vectors.description: An identity deactivated at the Account holds nothing, whatever its assignments. One removed from the Environment is unknown to it: the grants endpoint answers 404, which an SDK treats as a deny.

vectors.name: management-keys
vectors.description: A customer may define a permission named like one of Canopy's management keys. For an identity it grants the customer's permission, never Canopy's: evaluate denies it and the grant roots leave it out, so a local answer never allows what the server denies.

vectors.name: organization-membership
vectors.description: Inside the organizations container an assignment at the organization node or beneath it counts only while the holder's membership there is active. A deactivated membership leaves its assignments in place and they grant nothing: the grants read lists none of them, and a check answers ORGANIZATION_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE. A membership in another organization is untouched.

vectors.name: machine-clients
vectors.description: A machine OAuth client is a principal of its own: it holds roles at nodes beside identities, and its grant roots are read from the client's own grants endpoint, never an identity's. A client pinned to an organization holds roles only inside it, and they reach the nodes beneath it and nothing outside; an unpinned client holding a role at the root reaches the whole Environment. A person's grants are untouched by a client's.

vectors.name: holds-anywhere-under
vectors.description: holdsAnywhereUnder answers whether a permission is in effect anywhere in a subtree, for showing a menu or listing what a person may open, and names where: the subtree's root when a grant at it or above it reaches the whole subtree, otherwise the topmost grants inside it. It is not a guard. A grant deep inside an organization makes it true for the organization while a check at the organization node is still refused: the node checked must be the node the action writes to.

vectors.name: denies
vectors.description: A deny refuses its permissions to its target at its node and everything beneath it, before any grant is read, and no grant beneath it can undo it. Every office except Office A: the viewer role is denied documents.view at Office A, so its holders keep it at Office B and lose it at Office A and its team, unless they hold the compliance exception role anywhere. A grant made beneath the deny allows nothing there. A deny on one identity binds whatever roles it holds, and a deny on a machine client binds the client. Asked anywhere, a permission is held while one grant stands clear of every deny.
